searchText: Hi guys, Is there a tool for execution node multiplexer? I want to run one beacon node like lighthouse, with many EL nodes like geth, reth. How can I do that? I don’t think there’s anything that exists yet but https://github.com/TennisBowling/executionbackup would be a very good starting point. It would likely need to be updated to handle the extra couple of fields that op stack needs in forkChoiceUpdated calls. Shoot wrong discord. You can just use the execution backup as is for L1. It works great. 😊 Great thanks to you There is also factor, which we use to run geth for testing purposes: https://github.com/holiman/factor
